tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250tshe bdag lha mo tsaṇḍa lī ma'i brgyud 'debs bzhugs/ 1$0000300oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lho nub rnga yab zangs mdog dpal ri nas// gsang ba ye shes srin rgyal raksha'i phreng*// tshe bdag mthing 'od mandā ra ba dang*// mkha' 'gro 'bum sde rdo rje phag mo la// gsol ba 'debs so tshe yi dngos grub stsol// sindhu rgya mtshor brdzus skyes sprul sku dang*// 'od 'chang mkha' 'gro mā ra ti ka ru// tshe yi grogs mo lha lcam mandā ra// gsol ba 'debs so tshe yi dngos grub stsol// yang le shod du shākya de ma dang*// bod yul dbyangs can dpal mo mtsho rgyal ma// bkra shis khye 'dren kā la siddhi sogs// rigs ldan mkha' 'gro bye ba dung phyur la// gsol ba 'debs so tshe yi dngos grub stsol// 'od gsal nyams rtsal dkyil 'khor chen po nas// tshe yi lha mo tsaṇḍa lī ma dang*// dbang chen rta mchog thugs sgrub he ru kar// gsol ba 'debs so tshe yi dngos grub stsol// thun mong khyad par sngon 'gros rgyud sbyangs nas// sgo gsum tshe bdag ḍā kir gsal btab ste// 'od zer spro bsdu 'phro 'dus tshe bcud bsdus// gzhon nu bum pa'i sku ru rtag brtan shog /gzhan yang mi 'gyur tshe yi g.yung drung brtan// tshe yi rtsa ba lcags kyi srog rtsa 'grub// 'pho chen 'ja' lus rdo rje'i go 'phang thob// 'brel tshad don ldan mngon 'tshang rgya bar shog /
ces pa 'di mchims phu'i dben gnas su mgyogs par bris pa (padma chos 'byor rgya mtsho/)yin no/// /
